import json, pathlib, sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".claude/hooks"); import transcript_privacy as tp

selected = [p for p in sorted(root.iterdir()) if p.is_dir() and (
    any(p.name.endswith(f"_c6117488-{n:02d}") for n in (6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 13, 14, 15)) or p.name.endswith("_569f827e-01"))]
ident = tp.detect_identity(pathlib.Path("."))
values = {f"{k}#{i}": v for k, vals in ident.items() for i, v in enumerate(vals) if v and len(v) >= 3}
values.update({"personal email prefix": "[REDACTED:private-term]", "first name": "[REDACTED:private-term]", "third-party name": "[REDACTED:private-term]", "LAN IP": "[REDACTED:ip]"})
plan = {l for l in map(tp._normalize_line, pathlib.Path("docs/implementation-plan.md").read_text().splitlines()) if len(l) >= tp.MIN_FILE_LINE_CHARS}
public = {"|---|---|---|", "|---|---|---|---|", "src/etf_risk/", "flowchart TD", "implementation-plan.md", "test_spark_equivalence.py"}
public |= {f"| {t} | 1,508 | 2020-01-02 | 2025-12-31 |" for t in ("NVDA", "AAPL", "MSFT", "TSLA")}
fake_emails = {"noreply@anthropic.com", "git@github.com"}
print(f"selected folders: {len(selected)}")
for f in selected:
    recs = [json.loads(l) for l in (f / "transcript.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    msgs = [r for r in recs if r.get("type") in ("user", "assistant")]
    last = msgs[-1]; c = last["message"].get("content")
    last_kinds = [b.get("type") for b in c] if isinstance(c, list) else ["text"]
    shared = (f / "transcript.jsonl").read_text() + (f / "transcript.md").read_text()
    hits = {k: n for k, v in values.items() if (n := shared.lower().count(v.lower()))}
    emails = sorted({e for e in tp.EMAIL.findall(shared) if e.lower() not in fake_emails and "pytest" not in e})
    thinking_left = sum(1 for r in recs if r.get("type") == "assistant" for b in (r["message"].get("content") or [])
                        if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("type") == "thinking" and b.get("thinking") != "[REDACTED:model-reasoning]")
    other_plan = sum(1 for l in shared.splitlines() if tp._normalize_line(l) in plan and tp._normalize_line(l) not in public)
    files = sorted(p.name for p in f.iterdir())
    print(f"{f.name}: last record={last['type']} {last_kinds} | identity={hits or 'none'} | emails={emails or 'none'} | "
          f"ips={tp.PRIVATE_IPV4.findall(shared) or 'none'} | secrets={len(tp.SECRET_TOKEN.findall(shared))} | "
          f"reasoning left={thinking_left} | non-public plan lines={other_plan} | files={files}")
EOF
